case_metadata.project_goal: Generate a baseline from a global policy and a third-party standard

analysis_scope.analysis_objective: Parse two source documents, classify their overlaps, and generate a complete baseline package
assumptions: The workflow accepts PDF, markdown, or text source documents
Skill02 uses Azure OpenAI for baseline classification and analysis
Skill03 uses Azure OpenAI for final workbook wording and summaries

output_expectations.global_policy_parse: Structured parse artifact for the global policy
output_expectations.third_party_standard_parse: Structured parse artifact for the third-party standard
output_expectations.baseline_report: Markdown report summarizing analysis and resulting baseline decisions
output_expectations.baseline_controls: Markdown control list with traceability to both sources
output_expectations.final_baseline_xlsx: Production workbook with fixed sheets and validated schema for baseline review and downstream operations
